checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan: finish in-flight lacon work - align CLI/RLM test expectations with smart shrinking, wire the unused CSV/JSON parsers into Lacon.ask, replace the root-level scratch scripts with real tests, and refresh README test documentation

impact_assessment.why: The working tree fixes two stale assertions but leaves three scratch files at the repository root. unittest discovery imports test_features.py and runs its prints, the CSV/JSON parsers are dead code because ask() still calls sentences(), and JSON parsing drops numeric values. The in-flight work is not honest until the feature is wired and covered.
impact_assessment.benefits: Makes the recently added format parsers reachable through the public API, preserves numeric JSON values, converts manual probes into regression tests, removes root-level test pollution, and keeps README claims accurate.
impact_assessment.risks: Contract: new keyword-only Lacon.ask(context_format=...) defaulting to auto; JSON/CSV contexts now parse structurally instead of as plain sentences. Dependency: stdlib only. Concurrency: none. State: no persisted state changes. A deliberately small context_format value can fall back to text by design.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add tests/test_formats.py for parsers, auto-detection, format answers and the tree-wide budget, plus tests/test_code_understanding.py for AST extraction; run python -m unittest discover and python aikit.py check lacon before committing.

checkpoints.description: [2/2] Milestone 1 completed: wired Lacon.ask to the CSV/JSON/text readers via context_format, kept JSON keys and numeric values, replaced the root scratch scripts with 16 format/code-understanding tests, aligned the shrinking expectations, and refreshed README examples and test coverage notes.

[2/2] Phase 4 verification: python aikit.py check lacon passed 4/4 (test, hygiene, guidelines, secrets); checklists: passed; unittest discovery runs 106 tests green and no longer imports root-level scratch scripts.
